finding.summary: `Sheet.fetchGridByReferences` calls `toSrefs` on the calculator's unexpanded cross-sheet unbounded reference and throws, aborting the whole recalculation pass instead of yielding `#ERROR!` as the design doc promises.
finding.evidence: calculator.ts:94-95 passes `extractReferences(formula)` (still containing `SHEET2!A:A`) into `sheet.fetchGridByReferences`, whose first statement is `for (const sref of toSrefs(references))` at sheet.ts:2615 → parseRange('A:A') throws. Unlike `evaluate`/`evaluateWithSpill` (formula.ts:547,569 wrap in try/catch → ErrValue.ERROR), this throw is outside any catch, so it escapes `calculate()` and kills recalculation for every remaining cell in `sorted`. Contradicts docs/design/sheets/formula.md:128-131 ("evaluate to `#ERROR!`"). Fix belongs either here or in the new calculator code (expand or drop cross-sheet unbounded refs).
